annotations.target_phrase: the suborbital flight to Narita, stratospheric arc above the Pacific
annotations.annotation_text: The departure from Japan via suborbital transport marks the geographical transition from East Asian technological fringe to the American continental core. Gibson visualizes the Pacific Rim as a seamless network of hypersonic transit lanes connecting corporate fiefdoms.
sources: Tatsumi, Takayuki. Full Metal Apache. Duke UP, 2006.

annotations.target_phrase: fingering the shuriken in his pocket, points pressing against denim
annotations.annotation_text: Case gripping the shuriken during flight underscores the transition between physical danger and virtual conflict. The weapon anchors his tactile memory of the street as he prepares to re-enter cyberspace.
sources: Olsen, Lance. William Gibson. Borgo Press, 1992.
